data.description: RED task. Implement compute_mutations(prev_snapshot, next_snapshot) -> list in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py. Compares two snapshot dicts, emits {op, key, field, value} mutations, skips any field in EXCLUDED_FIELDS imported from config.py. Pure function — no I/O. Unit tests: excluded fields produce zero mutations, identical snapshots produce empty list, create/delete/update ops, purity check (no file/network imports).
data.title: Implement pure-function differ that excludes EXCLUDED_FIELDS from mutation list
